_comment: Committed quality floor for the visa classifier. CI fails below these. Keys are either a report-level attribute (accuracy, macro_f1, ...) or '<class>.<metric>'. Per-class entries are skipped when that class has no support in the labelled set, so the file can be tightened as the golden set grows. Raise these only with a commit that shows the measured improvement; lowering one is a deliberate, reviewable act.
